Fixture for the plain-japanese firing tests. `announce.md` is a release
note in the state a draft arrives in: sentences that join two claims
with が and ので, a subject that never meets its predicate, の stacked
three deep, an honorific doubled, the same term spelled two ways, the
conclusion in the last paragraph, and a link whose text is こちら.
`ui.md` holds a handful of UI strings with the same defects at
sentence scale.
